text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 testing involves analyzing samples to determine if someone is currently infected with the SARS-CoV-2 virus, or if they have previously been infected. The two main types of tests are molecular (PCR) tests, which detect active viral infection, and antigen tests, which detect specific proteins of the virus. There are also tests to detect antibodies, which indicate past infection. At-home OTC COVID-19 tests are available, including antigen tests, and have been authorized by the FDA for self-testing (FDA.gov).
